say: This is Ada. Ada has an app called Zedu. Lots of people use it every day.
Ada has lots of little robot helpers. At night, while Ada sleeps, the robots fix things in her app.
But Ada worries. What if a robot broke something while she was asleep?
So when Ada wakes up, Ziki tells her one simple thing first. Your app is fine. Two things need you.
Thing one. A robot's change made the app freeze for some people. The other robots saw it and put it back, all by themselves. Now they ask Ada: should every robot learn this lesson?
Thing two. A robot wants to paint the buttons green. Big changes like colours are Ada's choice, so the robots wait. Ada can say yes, say no, or ask a question.
Everything else the robots did went fine, so Ziki tucks it into one short line. And if Ada does not like something, she can press undo.
Ada gives the robots simple rules. Small fixes? Go ahead. Big changes? Ask me first.
Now Ada can sleep well, and her robots keep working. All clear!
